```{r Data preparation}
#install.packages("gllvm")
library(gllvm)
library(dplyr)
#library(tidyverse)
set.seed(0)
data(microbialdata)
microbial = data.frame(microbialdata)
dim(microbial)

Xenv = microbial[, 986:991]
df_noXenv = microbial %>%  #no X variables 
    dplyr::select(-(Xenv.SOM:Xenv.Soiltype))
```


```{r gllvm LA 1 l.v.}
# Function to fit generating ('true') GLLVM model and obtain fitted conditional mean values
model_and_pred = function(Y, X, l.v.){
  # Fit Poisson GLLVM using Laplace Approximation
  # Y = n x J responses
  # X = n x p environmental covariates
  # l.v. = no. of latent variables
  true_model = gllvm(Y, X, num.lv = l.v., family = poisson(link = 'log'), method = "LA", gradient.check = TRUE)
  # Obtain fitted conditional response means, including contribution from predicted latent variables
  pred_counts = predict(true_model, type = 'response', lv.pred=TRUE)
  #Return original data, fitted generating model, fitted conditional means
  return(list(Y = Y, X = X, true_model = true_model, pred_counts = pred_counts))
}

# No. of simulated datasets
B = 100

# Generating model with 1 latent variable
# Fit original microbial dataset with 1 l.v.

#model_pred = model_and_pred(Y = microbial[, 1:200], X = as.matrix(scale(Xenv[, 1:2])), l.v. = 1) 
#save(model_pred, file = "model_pred.RDATA")
load("model_pred.RDATA")

# Generate B simulated datasets conditionally on l.v. from fitted generating model
# Simulations stored as stacked 56 x 200 datasets

#sim_counts_all = simulate(model_pred$true_model, nsim = B, conditional = TRUE) #turn into 3D array 
#sim_counts_all = array(sim_counts_all, dim = c(nRow = 56, nsim = B, nVar = 200))

#save(sim_counts_all, file = "sim_counts_all.RDATA")
load("sim_counts_all.RDATA")

# Create folder where fitted gllvms are stored
dir.create("gllvm_models", showWarnings = TRUE)
# Storage for simulation results
time_all_gllvm1 = rep(NA, B) #fitting time for each of the simulations
KL_all_gllvm1 = rep(NA, B) #KL divergence between generating conditional means and fitted conditional means
loglik_new_all_gllvm1 = rep(NA, B) #conditional Poisson log-likelihood

# Environmental covariated used in each fitted model
X = scale(Xenv[, 1:2])
# No. of l.v.
l.v. = 1
set.seed(0)

# Refit gllvm with 1 l.v. to each simulated dataset
for (k in 1:B){
  time_i = system.time({
    gllvm_sim_1 = gllvm(y = sim_counts_all[, k, ], X = X, num.lv = l.v., family = poisson(link = 'log'), method = "LA")}) 
  
  # Save fitted GLLVM from each simulation 
  save(gllvm_sim_1, file = file.path("gllvm_models", paste0("gllvm_sim_1_", k, ".RDATA")))

  # Conditional means from original generating model
  true_mu = model_pred$pred_counts
  
  # Obtain fitted Poisson conditional means from refitted model
  pred_mu = predict(gllvm_sim_1, type = 'response', lv.pred = TRUE) #account for latent variable
  
  mu = pred_mu
  
  # 'log(mu)'
  eta = predict(gllvm_sim_1, type = 'link', lv.pred = TRUE) 
  KL = sum(true_mu*(log(true_mu) - eta) - (true_mu - pred_mu))

  # Store summary quantities
  time_all_gllvm1[k] = as.numeric(time_i[3])
  KL_all_gllvm1[k] = KL
  loglik_new_all_gllvm1[k] = sum(dpois(sim_counts_all[ , k, ], lambda = mu, log = TRUE)) # treats u as fixed parameters 
#  loglik_builtin_all_gllvm1[k] = gllvm_sim_1$logL #treats u as latent variables where integral needs to be marginalised over u
}

save(time_all_gllvm1, KL_all_gllvm1, loglik_new_all_gllvm1, file = file.path("gllvm_models", "gllvm1_summary.RDATA"))
load(file.path("gllvm_models", "gllvm1_summary.RDATA"))
time_all_gllvm1
KL_all_gllvm1
loglik_new_all_gllvm1
```

```{r alternating glms using 1 l.v.}
# Number of simulated datasets
B = 100

# Load fitted generating model, B simulated datasets as conacatenated 56 x 200 blocks
load("model_pred.RDATA")
load("sim_counts_all.RDATA")

# KL divergence should be outside
# Fit alt_glm to B simulated datasets
dir.create("glm_models", showWarnings = TRUE)
source("alt_glm.R")

time_all_glm1 = rep(NA, B)
KL_all_glm1 = rep(NA, B)
ite_converge_all_glm1 = rep(NA, B)
loglik_new_all_glm1 = rep(NA, B)
X = scale(Xenv[, 1:2])
set.seed(0)

for (k in 1:B){ #start here for function - input Y, X
  glm_sim_1 = try(alt_glm(sim_counts = sim_counts_all[ , k, ], X = X, u = as.matrix(rnorm(56, 0, 1)), N = 100), silent = TRUE)
  
    if (inherits(glm_sim_1, "try-error")) {
  cat("Simulation", k, "failed:\n",
      as.character(glm_sim_1),
      "\n")
    ite_converge_all_glm1[k] = NA
    time_all_glm1[k] = NA
    KL_all_glm1[k] = NA
    loglik_new_all_glm1[k] = NA
    
    next
    }
    
  save(glm_sim_1, file = file.path("glm_models", paste0("glm_sim_1_", k, ".RDATA")))
  true_mu = model_pred$pred_counts
  pred_mu = glm_sim_1$pred_counts
  eta = glm_sim_1$eta
  KL = sum(true_mu*(log(true_mu) - eta) - (true_mu - pred_mu))
  # Store summary quantities
  ite_converge_all_glm1[k] = glm_sim_1$ite_converge
  time_all_glm1[k] = glm_sim_1$time
  KL_all_glm1[k] = KL
  loglik_new_all_glm1[k] = glm_sim_1$loglik_new
}

save(time_all_glm1, KL_all_glm1, ite_converge_all_glm1, loglik_new_all_glm1, file = file.path("glm_models", "glm1_summary.RDATA"))

load(file.path("glm_models", "glm1_summary.RDATA"))
time_all_glm1
KL_all_glm1
ite_converge_all_glm1
loglik_new_all_glm1
```


```{r alternating glms using 2 l.v.}
# Generating model with 2 latent variables
# look into katana for computation clusters 
library(MASS)
set.seed(0)
load("model_pred_2.RDATA")
load("sim_counts_all_2.RDATA")

time_all_glm2 = rep(NA, B)
KL_all_glm2 = rep(NA, B)
ite_converge_all_glm2 = rep(NA, B)
loglik_new_all_glm2 = rep(NA, B)
X = scale(Xenv[, 1:2])
set.seed(0)

for (k in 1:B){
  glm_sim_2 = try(alt_glm(sim_counts = sim_counts_all_2[ , k, ], X = X, u = mvrnorm(n = 56, mu = c(0, 0), Sigma = matrix(c(1, 0, 0, 1), nrow = 2, ncol = 2)), N = 200), silent = TRUE) 
  
  if (inherits(glm_sim_2, "try-error")) {
  cat("Simulation", k, "failed:\n",
      as.character(glm_sim_2),
      "\n")
    ite_converge_all_glm2[k] = NA
    time_all_glm2[k] = NA
    KL_all_glm2[k] = NA
    loglik_new_all_glm2[k] = NA
    
    next
    }

  save(glm_sim_2, file = file.path("glm_models", paste0("glm_sim_2_", k, ".RDATA")))
  
  true_mu = model_pred_2$pred_counts
  pred_mu = glm_sim_2$pred_counts
  eta = glm_sim_2$eta
  KL = sum(true_mu*(log(true_mu) - eta) - (true_mu - pred_mu))
  
  ite_converge_all_glm2[k] = glm_sim_2$ite_converge
  time_all_glm2[k] = glm_sim_2$time
  KL_all_glm2[k] = KL
  loglik_new_all_glm2[k] = glm_sim_2$loglik_new
}

save(time_all_glm2, KL_all_glm2, ite_converge_all_glm2, loglik_new_all_glm2, file = file.path("glm_models", "glm2_summary.RDATA"))

load(file.path("glm_models", "glm2_summary.RDATA"))
time_all_glm2
KL_all_glm2
ite_converge_all_glm2
loglik_new_all_glm2
```


```{r jmle 1 l.v. K = ncol(sim_counts)}

B = 100

# Load generating model, simulated datasets
load("model_pred.RDATA")
load("sim_counts_all.RDATA")

# Fit jmle to B simulated datasets
dir.create("jmle_models", showWarnings = TRUE)
dir.create("jmle_models/ncolcounts", showWarnings = TRUE)

source("jmle.R")
source("proc.R")

time_all_jmle1 = rep(NA, B)
KL_all_jmle1 = rep(NA, B)
ite_converge_all_jmle1 = rep(NA, B)
loglik_new_all_jmle1 = rep(NA, B)
X = scale(Xenv[, 1:2])
set.seed(0)

for (k in 1:B){
  jmle_sim_1 = jmle(sim_counts = sim_counts_all[ , k, ], X = X, u = as.matrix(rnorm(56, 0, 1)), K = ncol(sim_counts_all[ , 1, ]), N = 1000)
  
  save(jmle_sim_1, file = file.path("jmle_models/ncolcounts", paste0("jmle_sim_1_", k, ".RDATA")))
  
  true_mu = model_pred$pred_counts
  pred_mu = jmle_sim_1$pred_counts
  eta = jmle_sim_1$eta
  KL = sum(true_mu*(log(true_mu) - eta) - (true_mu - pred_mu))
  
  # Store summary quantities
  ite_converge_all_jmle1[k] = jmle_sim_1$ite_converge
  time_all_jmle1[k] = jmle_sim_1$time
  KL_all_jmle1[k] = KL
  loglik_new_all_jmle1[k] = jmle_sim_1$loglik_new
}  

save(time_all_jmle1, KL_all_jmle1, ite_converge_all_jmle1, loglik_new_all_jmle1, file = file.path("jmle_models/ncolcounts", "jmle1_summary.RDATA"))
load(file.path("jmle_models/ncolcounts", "jmle1_summary.RDATA"))
time_all_jmle1
KL_all_jmle1
ite_converge_all_jmle1
loglik_new_all_jmle1
```


```{r jmle, 2 l.v. K = ncol(sim_counts)}
# Generating model with 2 latent variables
load("model_pred_2.RDATA")
load("sim_counts_all_2.RDATA")
library(MASS)
time_all_jmle2 = rep(NA, B)
KL_all_jmle2 = rep(NA, B)
ite_converge_all_jmle2 = rep(NA, B)
loglik_new_all_jmle2 = rep(NA, B)
X = scale(Xenv[, 1:2])
set.seed(0)

for (k in 1:B){
  jmle_sim_2 = try(jmle(sim_counts = sim_counts_all_2[ , k, ], X = X, u = mvrnorm(56, c(0, 0), diag(2)), K = ncol(sim_counts_all_2[ , 1, ]), N = 1000), silent = TRUE)
  
  if (inherits(jmle_sim_2, "try-error")) {
cat("Simulation", k, "failed:\n",
    as.character(jmle_sim_2),
    "\n")
  ite_converge_all_jmle2[k] = NA
  time_all_jmle2[k] = NA
  KL_all_jmle2[k] = NA
  loglik_new_all_jmle2[k] = NA
  
  next
  }

  save(jmle_sim_2, file = file.path("jmle_models/ncolcounts", paste0("jmle_sim_2_", k, ".RDATA")))

  true_mu = model_pred_2$pred_counts
  pred_mu = jmle_sim_2$pred_counts
  eta = jmle_sim_2$eta
  KL = sum(true_mu*(log(true_mu) - eta) - (true_mu - pred_mu))
  
  ite_converge_all_jmle2[k] = jmle_sim_2$ite_converge
  time_all_jmle2[k] = jmle_sim_2$time
  KL_all_jmle2[k] = KL
  loglik_new_all_jmle2[k] = jmle_sim_2$loglik_new
}  

save(time_all_jmle2, KL_all_jmle2, ite_converge_all_jmle2, loglik_new_all_jmle2, file = file.path("jmle_models/ncolcounts", "jmle2_summary.RDATA"))
load(file.path("jmle_models/ncolcounts", "jmle2_summary.RDATA"))
time_all_jmle2
KL_all_jmle2
ite_converge_all_jmle2
loglik_new_all_jmle2
```

```{r jmle, 1 l.v., K = sqrt(ncol(sim_counts))}
B = 100

# Load generating model, simulated datasets
load("model_pred.RDATA")
load("sim_counts_all.RDATA")

# Fit jmle to B simulated datasets
dir.create("jmle_models", showWarnings = TRUE)
dir.create("jmle_models/sqrt", showWarnings = TRUE)

source("jmle.R")
source("proc.R")

time_all_jmle_sqrt1 = rep(NA, B)
KL_all_jmle_sqrt1 = rep(NA, B)
ite_converge_all_jmle_sqrt1 = rep(NA, B)
loglik_new_all_jmle_sqrt1 = rep(NA, B)
X = scale(Xenv[, 1:2])
set.seed(0)

for (k in 1:B){
  jmle_sqrt_sim_1 = jmle(sim_counts = sim_counts_all[ , k, ], X = X, u = as.matrix(rnorm(56, 0, 1)), K = sqrt(ncol(sim_counts_all[, 1, ])) , N = 1000)
  
  save(jmle_sqrt_sim_1, file = file.path("jmle_models/sqrt", paste0("jmle_sqrt_sim_1_", k, ".RDATA")))
  
  true_mu = model_pred$pred_counts
  pred_mu = jmle_sqrt_sim_1$pred_counts
  eta = jmle_sqrt_sim_1$eta
  KL = sum(true_mu*(log(true_mu) - eta) - (true_mu - pred_mu))
  
  # Store summary quantities
  ite_converge_all_jmle_sqrt1[k] = jmle_sqrt_sim_1$ite_converge
  time_all_jmle_sqrt1[k] = jmle_sqrt_sim_1$time
  KL_all_jmle_sqrt1[k] = KL
  loglik_new_all_jmle_sqrt1[k] = jmle_sqrt_sim_1$loglik_new
}  

save(time_all_jmle_sqrt1, KL_all_jmle_sqrt1, ite_converge_all_jmle_sqrt1, loglik_new_all_jmle_sqrt1, file = file.path("jmle_models/sqrt", "jmle1_sqrt_summary.RDATA"))
```

```{r Plotting}
f_all = list(
  gllvm_LA1 = rep(NA, B), gllvm_LA2 = rep(NA, B),
  gllvm_VA1 = rep(NA, B), gllvm_VA2 = rep(NA, B),

  glm1 = rep(NA, B), glm2 = rep(NA, B),

  glmnet_pen0.1_1 = rep(NA, B), glmnet_pen0.1_2 = rep(NA, B),
  glmnet_pen0.01_1 = rep(NA, B), glmnet_pen0.01_2 = rep(NA, B)
)

load_fit = function(file) {
  obj = load(file)
  get(obj)
  }

model_info = list(
  gllvm_LA = list(path = "gllvm_models", 
                  file = "gllvm_sim_%d_%d.RDATA"),
  gllvm_VA = list(path = "gllvm_models/VA", 
                  file = "gllvm_sim_VA%d_%d.RDATA"),
  glm = list(path = "glm_models", 
             file = "glm_sim_%d_%d.RDATA"),
  jmle_ncolcounts = list(path = "jmle_models/ncolcounts", 
                         file = "jmle_sim_%d_%d.RDATA"),
  jmle_ncolu = list(path = "jmle_models/ncolu", 
                    file = "jmle_ncolu_sim_%d_%d.RDATA"),
  jmle_sqrt = list(path = "jmle_models/sqrt", 
                   file = "jmle_sqrt_sim_%d_%d.RDATA"),
  glmnet_pen1 = list(path = "glmnet_models/pen1", 
                     file = "glmnet_sim_%d_%d.RDATA"),
  glmnet_pen0.1 = list(path = "glmnet_models/pen0.1", 
                       file = "glmnet_pen0.1_sim_%d_%d.RDATA"),
  glmnet_pen0.01 = list(path = "glmnet_models/pen0.01", 
                        file = "glmnet_pen0.01_sim_%d_%d.RDATA")
)

for (i in 1:B) {
  for (lv in 1:2) {
    for (method in names(model_info)) {
      model = model_info[[method]]
      fit = try(load_fit(file.path(model$path, sprintf(model$file, lv, i))), silent = TRUE)
      
      if (inherits(fit, "try-error")) {
      cat("No file found for the", i, "th simulation\n")
        
      f_all[[paste0(method, lv)]][i] = NA
      
      next
      }
      
      if (method %in% c("gllvm_LA", "gllvm_VA")) {
        u = fit$lvs
        lambda = fit$params$theta %*% diag(fit$params$sigma.lv, nrow = lv, ncol = lv)
      } else {
        u = fit$u
        lambda = fit$lambda
      }
      
      ULambda = identify_ulambda(u, lambda)
      Lambda = ULambda$Lambda
      f_all[[paste0(method, lv)]][i] = norm(Lambda %*% t(Lambda), type = "F")
    }
  }
}

  f2 = c(f_all$gllvm_LA2, f_all$gllvm_VA2, f_all$glm2, f_all$jmle_ncolcounts2, f_all$jmle_ncolu2, f_all$jmle_sqrt2, f_all$glmnet_pen1_2, f_all$glmnet_pen0.1_2, f_all$glmnet_pen0.01_2)
)
  
sim_plot = function(y, ylab, title, ylim = NULL){
  g = ggplot(data = df, aes(x = method, y = {{y}}, color = method)) + 
  ylab(ylab) + xlab("") +
  ggtitle(title) + 
  guides(color = FALSE) +
  geom_boxplot(lwd = 0.5, fill = NA) +
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10, limits = ylim) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "gllvm_LA" = "#000000",
    "gllvm_VA" = "#000000",
    "alt_glm" = "#E69F00",
    "jmle_ncolcounts" = "#0072B2",
    "jmle_ncolu" = "#0072B2",
    "jmle_sqrt" = "#0072B2",
    "alt_glmnet_pen1" = "#CC79A7",
    "alt_glmnet_pen0.1" = "#CC79A7",
    "alt_glmnet_pen0.01" = "#CC79A7"
    )) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
    "gllvm_LA" = "gllvm\nLA",
    "gllvm_VA" = "gllvm\nVA",
    "alt_glm" = "alt_glm",
    "jmle_ncolcounts" = "jmle\nncolcounts",
    "jmle_ncolu" = "jmle\nncolu",
    "jmle_sqrt" = "jmle\nsqrt",
    "alt_glmnet_pen1" = "alt_glmnet\npen1",
    "alt_glmnet_pen0.1" = "alt_glmnet\npen0.1",
    "alt_glmnet_pen0.01" = "alt_glmnet\npen0.01")) +
   theme_bw()
}

sim_log_plot = function(y, ylab, title, ylim = NULL){
  g = ggplot(data = df, aes(x = method, y = {{y}}, color = method)) + 
  ylab(ylab) + xlab("") +
  ggtitle(title) + 
  guides(color = FALSE) +
  geom_boxplot(lwd = 0.5, fill = NA) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = ylim, trans = "log", labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 1)) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "gllvm_LA" = "#000000",

    "jmle_ncolcounts" = "#0072B2",
    "jmle_ncolu" = "#0072B2",
    "jmle_sqrt" = "#0072B2",
    "alt_glmnet_pen1" = "#CC79A7",
    "alt_glmnet_pen0.1" = "#CC79A7",

    )) +

    "gllvm_LA" = "gllvm\nLA",

    "alt_glm" = "alt_glm",
    "jmle_ncolcounts" = "jmle\nncolcounts",
    "jmle_ncolu" = "jmle\nncolu",
    "jmle_sqrt" = "jmle\nsqrt",
    "alt_glmnet_pen1" = "alt_glmnet\npen1",

}
```

```{r KL, time, frobenius diff trimmed outliers for mean, sd}
trim_summary = function(x) {
  stats = boxplot.stats(x)$stats
  x_trim = x[x >= stats[1] & x <= stats[5]]
  
  c(mean = mean(x_trim, na.rm = TRUE),
           sd = sd(x_trim, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}
```

```{r running gllvm 2 l.v. LA}

# Generating model with 2 latent variables
dir.create("presentation/gllvm_models", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = TRUE)

model_pred_2 = model_and_pred(Y = microbial[, 1:100], X = as.matrix(scale(Xenv[, 1:2])), l.v. = 2) 

sim_counts_all_2 = simulate(model_pred_2$true_model, nsim = B, conditional = TRUE)
sim_counts_all_2 = array(sim_counts_all_2, dim = c(nRow = 56, nsim = B, nVar = 100))


time_all_gllvmLA = rep(NA, B)
KL_all_gllvmLA = rep(NA, B)
loglik_new_all_gllvmLA = rep(NA, B)
X = scale(Xenv[, 1:2])
l.v. = 2
set.seed(0)

for (k in 1:B){
  time_i = system.time({
    gllvm_sim_LA = gllvm(y = sim_counts_all_2[ , k, ], X = X, num.lv = l.v., family = poisson(link = 'log'), method = "LA")}) 
  
  save(gllvm_sim_LA, file = file.path("presentation/gllvm_models", paste0("gllvm_sim_LA_", k, ".RDATA")))

  true_mu = model_pred_2$pred_counts
  pred_mu = predict(gllvm_sim_LA, type = 'response', lv.pred = TRUE) #account for latent variable
  mu = pred_mu
  eta = predict(gllvm_sim_LA, type = 'link', lv.pred = TRUE) 
  KL = sum(true_mu*(log(true_mu) - eta) - (true_mu - pred_mu))
  
  time_all_gllvmLA[k] = as.numeric(time_i[3])
  KL_all_gllvmLA[k] = KL
  loglik_new_all_gllvmLA[k] = sum(dpois(sim_counts_all_2[ , k, ], lambda = mu, log = TRUE))
}

save(time_all_gllvmLA, KL_all_gllvmLA, loglik_new_all_gllvmLA, file = file.path("presentation/gllvm_models", "gllvm_LA_summary.RDATA"))

load(file.path("presentation/gllvm_models", "gllvm_LA_summary.RDATA"))
time_all_gllvmLA
KL_all_gllvmLA
loglik_new_all_gllvmLA
```

```{r alternating glms using 2 l.v.}
dir.create("presentation/glm_models", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = TRUE)
library(MASS)
set.seed(0)

time_all_glm = rep(NA, B)
KL_all_glm = rep(NA, B)
ite_converge_all_glm = rep(NA, B)
loglik_new_all_glm = rep(NA, B)
X = scale(Xenv[, 1:2])
set.seed(0)

for (k in 1:B){
  glm_sim = try(alt_glm(sim_counts = sim_counts_all_2[ , k, ], X = X, u = mvrnorm(n = 56, mu = c(0, 0), Sigma = matrix(c(1, 0, 0, 1), nrow = 2, ncol = 2)), N = 1000), silent = TRUE) 
  
  if (inherits(glm_sim, "try-error")) {
  cat("Simulation", k, "failed:\n",
      as.character(glm_sim),
      "\n")
    ite_converge_all_glm[k] = NA
    time_all_glm[k] = NA
    KL_all_glm[k] = NA
    loglik_new_all_glm[k] = NA
    
    next
    }

  save(glm_sim, file = file.path("presentation/glm_models", paste0("glm_sim_", k, ".RDATA")))
  
  true_mu = model_pred_2$pred_counts
  pred_mu = glm_sim$pred_counts
  eta = glm_sim$eta
  KL = sum(true_mu*(log(true_mu) - eta) - (true_mu - pred_mu))
  
  ite_converge_all_glm[k] = glm_sim$ite_converge
  time_all_glm[k] = glm_sim$time
  KL_all_glm[k] = KL
  loglik_new_all_glm[k] = glm_sim$loglik_new
}

save(time_all_glm, KL_all_glm, ite_converge_all_glm, loglik_new_all_glm, file = file.path("presentation/glm_models", "glm_summary.RDATA"))

load(file.path("presentation/glm_models", "glm_summary.RDATA"))
```
```{r Plotting}
load(file.path("presentation/jmle_models", "jmle_sqrt_summary.RDATA"))
load(file.path("presentation/glmnet_models", "glmnet_pen1_summary.RDATA"))

df = data.frame(
  method = factor(rep(c("LA", "VA", "alt_glm", "jmle", "PQL (AIRWLS)"), each = B), levels = c("LA", "VA", "alt_glm", "jmle", "PQL (AIRWLS)")),
  KL2 = c(KL_all_gllvmLA, KL_all_gllvmVA, KL_all_glm, KL_all_jmle_sqrt, KL_all_glmnet_pen1),
  time2 = c(time_all_gllvmLA, time_all_gllvmVA, time_all_glm, time_all_jmle_sqrt, time_all_glmnet_pen1)
)

sim_plot = function(df, y, ylab, title, ylim = NULL){
  g = ggplot(data = df, aes(x = method, y = {{y}}, color = method)) + 
  ylab(ylab) + xlab("") +
  ggtitle(title) + 
  guides(color = FALSE) +
  geom_boxplot(lwd = 0.5, fill = NA) +
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10, limits = ylim) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "LA" = "#000000",
    "VA" = "#E69F00",
    "alt_glm" = "#0072B2",
    "jmle" = "#009E73",
    "PQL (AIRWLS)" = "#CC79A7"
    )) +
   theme_bw()
}

sim_log_plot = function(df, y, ylab, title, ylim = NULL){
  g = ggplot(data = df, aes(x = method, y = {{y}}, color = method)) + 
  ylab(ylab) + xlab("") +
  ggtitle(title) + 
  guides(color = FALSE) +
  geom_boxplot(lwd = 0.5, fill = NA) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = ylim, trans = "log", labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 1)) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "LA" = "#000000",
    "VA" = "#E69F00",
    "alt_glm" = "#0072B2",
    "jmle" = "#009E73",
    "PQL (AIRWLS)" = "#CC79A7"
    )) +
  theme_bw()
}

g = sim_plot(df %>% dplyr::filter(method %in% c("LA", "VA")), y = KL2, ylab = "KL Divergence (2 l.v.)", title = "KL Divergence for 2 latent variables")#, ylim = c(400, 1000))
g
ggsave("presentation/figures/sim-LA-VA-KLD.png", width = 5.5, height = 4.5)

g = sim_log_plot(df %>% dplyr::filter(method %in% c("LA", "VA")), y = time2, ylab = "Computation Time (s) (log-scaled)", title = "Computation time for 2 latent variable (s)")
g
ggsave("presentation/figures/sim-LA-VA-time.png", width = 5.5, height = 4.5)


g = sim_plot(df %>% dplyr::filter(method %in% c("VA", "PQL (AIRWLS)")), y = KL2, ylab = "KL Divergence (2 l.v.)", title = "KL Divergence for 2 latent variables")#, ylim = c(400, 1000))
g
ggsave("presentation/figures/sim-VA-PQL-KLD.png", width = 5.5, height = 4.5)

g = sim_log_plot(df %>% dplyr::filter(method %in% c("VA", "PQL (AIRWLS)")), y = time2, ylab = "Computation Time (s) (log-scaled)", title = "Computation time for 2 latent variable (s)")
g
ggsave("presentation/figures/sim-VA-PQL-time.png", width = 5.5, height = 4.5)


g = sim_plot(df %>% dplyr::filter(method %in% c("PQL (AIRWLS)", "jmle")), y = KL2, ylab = "KL Divergence (2 l.v.)", title = "KL Divergence for 2 latent variables")#, ylim = c(400, 1000))
g
ggsave("presentation/figures/sim-PQL-jmle-KLD.png", width = 5.5, height = 4.5)

g = sim_log_plot(df %>% dplyr::filter(method %in% c("PQL (AIRWLS)", "jmle")), y = time2, ylab = "Computation Time (s) (log-scaled)", title = "Computation time for 2 latent variable (s)")
g
```
